articles.title: CDC Quietly Merges Overdose Tracking Systems — Is the New Dashboard Burying Inconvenient Data?

articles.title: Non-Coding RNA 7SK Drives Chemo Resistance in Tumors — And Nobody in Oncology Is Talking About It
articles.summary: PLOS Computational Biology researchers using single-cell analysis of patient tumor samples found that RNA 7SK — a molecule known for suppressing gene activity — paradoxically helps tumors survive chemotherapy by coupling local oncogenic activation with global transcriptional shutdown. This mechanism could explain why so many cancers develop treatment resistance, yet it sits outside the standard oncology drug-development pipeline entirely. Follow the money: there is no patent play in a non-coding RNA, so expect this finding to languish.
